Binance Launches First Regulated TradFi Perpetual Contracts Settled in Stablecoin, Starting with Gold and Silver. The contracts are offered by Nest Exchange Limited, a Binance entity regulated by the Financial Services Regulatory Authority of Abu Dhabi Global Market. Users can trade 24/7 with USDT settlement.
